record.paper_title: Some open problems on the classical function space L1
record.context_brief: embedding Banach subspaces of L0 into L1
record.original_question: Does every Banach space that can be realized as a subspace of L0 also embed into L1[0,1]?

evidence.quote: Problem 3. (Kwapień, [119]) Does every Banach subspace of L0 embed in L1?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $L_0 = L_0[0,1]$ denote the space of (equivalence classes of) Lebesgue measurable real-valued functions on $[0,1]$, equipped with the topology of convergence in measure (a complete metrizable topological vector space). Let $L_1 = L_1[0,1]$ denote the Banach space of Lebesgue integrable functions on $[0,1]$ with the usual norm $\|f\|_1 = \int_0^1 |f(t)|\,dt$.

Say that a Banach space $X$ embeds into $L_0$ if there exists a linear topological isomorphism from $X$ onto a closed linear subspace of $L_0$, and that $X$ embeds into $L_1$ if there exists a linear isomorphism from $X$ onto a closed linear subspace of $L_1$ (equivalently, a bounded linear injection $T: X \to L_1$ with closed range and bounded inverse on its range).

Question: Does every Banach space $X$ that embeds into $L_0$ also embed into $L_1$?
artifact.status_search_result: Kwapień's problem (1969) asks whether every Banach space embedding into L_0 (equivalently, into L_p for some 0 < p < 1) embeds into L_1. The isometric version was answered negatively by Kalton (1996), who constructed a Banach space embedding isometrically into L_{1/2} but not into L_1. The isomorphic version, which is the question stated here, remains open according to standard references on the subject.

status_evidence.title: Banach Spaces Embedding Isometrically into L_p (Kalton)
status_evidence.snippet: Kwapień's problem asks whether every Banach space embedding into L_p for some 0<p<1 also embeds into L_1; the isometric version was solved negatively, the isomorphic version remains open.
status_evidence.claim: The isomorphic version of Kwapień's problem (subspaces of L_0 embedding into L_1) is still open.

status_evidence.title: Banach spaces embedding into L_0 (Israel J. Math.)
status_evidence.snippet: Characterizations of Banach spaces embedding into L_0 and relations with embeddings into L_p for 0<p<1.
status_evidence.claim: The class of Banach spaces embedding into L_0 coincides with those embedding into L_p for some 0<p<1.
